full_context_review.scope: Complete actual H2 5 and9 prose and source-unit spans; no fixed section5 paragraph minimum or language-length heuristic. Cross-section applicability/meaning is independently reviewed separately.

actual_stored_projection_bodies.scope: All12 protocol fields, complete calculation/input/output, quality requirements/evidence, all measurement/property/unit bodies, source records, full row descriptions/amount evidence/basis/ranges, boundary/allocation/validation and reference fields. Literal and complete source/ancestor context checks are separate.

measurementRules.rule: M = accepted net mass of one complete machine of the same configuration in kg; collect using cp_mass.

Q sums actual first-release complete net ride masses, with each retained component/fluid/water once and packaging excluded. A physical 1 kg is a normalized fraction of a complete ride, not a standalone usable ride part.

Native quantities remain mass, energy, volume, count or service as actually measured. Convert kWh to MJ once with 3.6 MJ/kWh. Item(s) and item are identical count with factor 1, never a kg conversion. Count-to-mass uses actual configuration-specific calibrated M; never infer kg or density from secondary coefficients. Integrated volumes are not multiplied by time; only true rates are integrated. Whole-ride M applies only to the same complete ride configuration. Other part/package counts remain native count where appropriate; a needed mass bridge uses independently weighed same-article mass and actual state, never whole-ride M.

calculationRules.rule: Convert actual raw extensive units once and reconcile full physical V separately. For each exchange A_i=B_open_i+U_new_i-B_close_i-T_other_i, with U_new actual new material/service/provider/work/treatment burden addition BEFORE stock correction. B only raw/WIP/genuinely unused-unassigned stores/charges, never already released FG/performed service; already stock-corrected consumption uses its reconciled equivalent account without another stock correction or repeated own/provider history. True other cohort/function requires evidenced once-only handover. Physical disclosure v_i=V_i/Qanalysis uses a declared positive observation basis for the full actual event once; it is not linked full shared provider demand per cohort. Modeled demand a_i=A_i/originalQ0_i or a_i_h=A_i_h/originalQc in compatible provider units is attributed separately to each served original cohort exactly once. Never reduce physical transfers by service shares or recharge full receiver/provider Qt to every cohort. Q0 is locked unique first-acceptance mass; Q=0/unknown basis retains raw totals without unit result. Actual H and internal matched transfers remain explicit.

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Use only fully facet-compatible native flow and provider: every basename, synonym/comment, CAS, grade, polymer/particle structure, route, geography, type/media and all properties. An isolated class/comment anomaly is disclosed; a hard physical/chemical contradiction blocks that binding. Exact reference-property → unit-group versions and reference unit must be verified, never substituted with latest or Mass for energy.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Original raw records and independent reconciliations

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Retain complete route, original-source context, make/buy scope, actual configuration and acceptance; no invented recipe, yield, rating, lifetime, certification or plant observation.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Original raw records and independent reconciliations

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Require complete raw and vector stocks, gross packaging/asset/fluid legs and independent wet-mass/element/species constraints; mixed Waste total or components once with one provider. Unknown remains a quantified evidence gap.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Original raw records and independent reconciliations

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Preserve original measured cohort Qc, observed H, actual delivered/returned and performed work including unauthorized failures; future service remains unknown and never supplies retrospective new production.

measurementRules.rule: M = 同一配置的一台完整机器的验收净质量，单位 kg；采用 cp_mass 采集。
Q汇总真实首次放行完整设施净质量，每种内含组件流体水计一次并排除包装。物理1kg是完整设施的归一化部分，并非可单独使用的设施部件。
原生量按实测保留质量、能量、体积、件数或服务。kWh以3.6 MJ/kWh换算一次。Item(s)与item为同件数且因子1，不作kg换算。件数转质量使用真实配置专属校准M，不能从次级系数反推kg或密度。积分体积不再乘时间，仅真实速率才积分。 整机M仅适用于同一完整设施配置；其他部件包材件数可保留原生计数，若需质量桥，用独立实测同件质量及实际状态，绝不套整机M。

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 仅采用全部facet相容的原生流及供方：逐basename、同义词备注、CAS、等级、聚合物或粒子结构、路线、地区、type介质及全部属性。孤立分类备注异常须披露；硬物理化学冲突阻断该binding。核验精确参考属性→单位组版本→参考单位，不以latest或Mass代能量。
保留完整路线、原始来源上下文、自产外购范围、真实配置及验收，不编造配方良率额定值寿命认证或工厂观测。

保留原实测Qc、已观察H、真实交付返还及已执行作业含未授权失败；未来服务未知且不能追溯新增生产。
